name: tia_export_cross_references
description: Write the PLC cross-reference table (CrossReferenceService) of blocks and PLC tags to a JSONL file: one line per reference with source object and address, the referenced object (reference), location, access (Read/Write) and referenceType (Uses/UsedBy/...).

output_path.description: Full path of the .jsonl file to write (replaced if it exists).

plc_name.description: Exact PLC software name; required when the project has multiple PLCs.

object_names.description: Optional block or PLC tag names to limit the export.

include_tags.description: Include the PLC tags of all tag tables (default: true).
